My name is GIOVANNI!<PARAGRAPH>

Three years ago I used to
command TEAM ROCKET.<PARAGRAPH>

I disbanded TEAM ROCKET after
I was beaten by a guy<SCROLL>
named RED!<PARAGRAPH>

After that I went into training.<PARAGRAPH>

Then I learned that TEAM AQUA
was in need of a leader!<PARAGRAPH>

So I decided to become the
leader of TEAM AQUA.<PARAGRAPH>

I have loads of plans
in store for them!<PARAGRAPH>

For example.<PARAGRAPH>

The POKéMON behind me is
called REGIROCK.<PARAGRAPH>

It’s body is made entirely
out of rock!<PARAGRAPH>

It’s said that the rock
has come from all over<SCROLL>
the world!<PARAGRAPH>

REGIROCK is one of three
POKéMON called the REGIS.<PARAGRAPH>

TEAM AQUA wants all three
of the REGIS as part of<SCROLL>
my master plan!<PARAGRAPH>

REGIROCK is currently in a
deep sleep that’s lasted<SCROLL>
for over 200 years!<PARAGRAPH>

I was about to awaken REGIROCK
when you showed up.<PARAGRAPH>

Becuase of that I’m going
to have to eliminate you!
